about: Curated input for scripts/coverage-rank.ts (COVERAGE-RANK, notes/PM-2026-10-04.md). Usage numbers come from the snapshot files beside this one; Dragon's status is never written here, the script compiles every probe through the compiler. This file holds only judgement: which values to probe, which lane a feature belongs to, lane sizes and dependencies, and the not-applicable-on-native lists.

proposed.about: The PM's proposed NA-NATIVE list (notes/PM-2026-10-04.md); the NA-NATIVE lane confirms each against the code. Counted outside the denominator in the headline's second figure only.

items.cursor: a pointer cursor has no meaning on touch-native
items.will-change: a compositor hint; no visible or behavioural effect
items.scrollbar-color: native scroll indicators are not styleable this way
items.selector:::-webkit-scrollbar: web scrollbar styling; native draws its own scroll indicators
items.selector:::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb: web scrollbar styling; native draws its own scroll indicators
items.selector:::-webkit-scrollbar-track: web scrollbar styling; native draws its own scroll indicators

candidates.about: Further candidates found by COVERAGE-RANK. Not reviewed: each needs the owner's per-entry yes before it counts as not applicable. Shown, never subtracted from the headline.

items.-webkit-tap-highlight-color: the browser's tap flash; native views have none to style
items.-webkit-font-smoothing: macOS-only subpixel/greyscale switch; no effect on iOS or Android
items.text-rendering: a shaping-speed hint; Dragon shapes with HarfBuzz regardless (check optimizeLegibility kerning before accepting)
items.-webkit-text-size-adjust: mobile-browser text autosizing; native apps have none
items.text-size-adjust: mobile-browser text autosizing; native apps have none
items.at-rule:@charset: stylesheet encoding; Dragon reads UTF-8 source text, so accepting it is the whole job
items.-webkit-user-drag: desktop drag image; review against iOS drag and drop
items.speak: verify first: Blink parses speak but applies nothing; native speech goes through accessibility APIs
items.break-inside: printing and multi-column; not applicable only while MULTICOL stays out of scope
